wps.name: Corbulo's canal | Vlietwijk

wps.name: Zilveren schaats

recipes.story: 261 km from Utrecht to Utrecht, about 3 h 43 of riding. The stops in between: Corbulo's canal | Vlietwijk, Dutch Water Defence Lines and back through Corbulo's canal | Vlietwijk. The line favours views over speed.
